es.summary: Documento que reúne evidencia y recomendaciones para la práctica segura y eficaz del cuidado de salud.
key_points: Basada en evidencia científica y consenso multidisciplinario.
Adaptada a recursos y contexto local de Costa Rica.
Facilita la toma de decisiones y reduce la variabilidad del cuidado.

purpose: Establecer estándares de cuidado basados en la mejor evidencia disponible.
Mejorar la calidad y seguridad del paciente.
Promover la uniformidad en la práctica clínica.
Facilitar la educación continua del personal de salud.
procedure: Identificar la necesidad clínica o problema a abordar.
Revisar literatura y guías internacionales relevantes.
Evaluar la calidad de la evidencia (grado de recomendación).
Validar con expertos locales y adaptar al contexto costarricense.
Difundir la guía y planificar su implementación.
safety: Verificar que la evidencia sea actual y de alta calidad.
Evitar conflictos de interés en la elaboración.
Incluir advertencias sobre contraindicaciones y precauciones.
Asegurar que la guía sea accesible y comprensible para todo el personal.
nursing_care: Evaluar el nivel de conocimiento del paciente sobre la guía.
Educar al paciente y familia usando lenguaje claro y culturalmente apropiado.
Monitorear la adherencia a las recomendaciones de la guía.
Reportar barreras de implementación al equipo interdisciplinario.
documentation: Registrar la versión, fecha de publicación y fuente de la guía.
Anotar en la historia clínica la educación brindada y la comprensión del paciente.
Documentar cualquier desviación de la guía y su justificación.

interventions.rationale: Proporciona referencia accesible para el paciente y su familia.

interventions.rationale: Garantiza continuidad del cuidado y permite evaluar la efectividad de la intervención.

en.summary: Document that gathers evidence and recommendations for safe and effective health care practice.
key_points: Based on scientific evidence and multidisciplinary consensus.
Updated periodically according to new studies.
Adapted to resources and local context of Costa Rica.
Facilitates decision making and reduces care variability.

purpose: Establish care standards based on the best available evidence.
Facilitate ongoing education for health personnel.
procedure: Identify the clinical need or problem to address.
Review relevant literature and international guidelines.
Assess the quality of evidence (grade of recommendation).
Validate with local experts and adapt to the Costa Rican context.
Disseminate the guideline and plan its implementation.
safety: Verify that the evidence is current and of high quality.
Avoid conflicts of interest in development.
Include warnings about contraindications and precautions.
Ensure the guideline is accessible and understandable to all staff.
nursing_care: Assess the patient’s knowledge level about the guideline.
Educate the patient and family using clear, culturally appropriate language.
Monitor adherence to the guideline recommendations.
Report implementation barriers to the interdisciplinary team.
documentation: Record the version, publication date, and source of the guideline.
Note in the medical record the education provided and patient understanding.
Document any deviations from the guideline and their justification.

outcomes: Patient knowledge: demonstrate understanding of the clinical guideline (80% correct responses)

interventions.action: Provide individualized education about the guideline using visual materials and simple language.
interventions.rationale: Facilitates comprehension and retention of information.

interventions.action: Verify understanding through open questions and feedback.
interventions.rationale: Identifies knowledge gaps and corrects them immediately.

interventions.action: Provide printed copies of the guideline in Spanish and explain its practical use.
interventions.rationale: Provides an accessible reference for the patient and family.

interventions.action: Schedule follow-up reviews to reinforce concepts and address questions.
interventions.rationale: Reinforces learning and improves long-term adherence.

interventions.action: Document the education provided and the patient’s response in the medical record.
interventions.rationale: Ensures continuity of care and allows evaluation of intervention effectiveness.
